5 تمحّص [It became clear, pure, free from every admixture or imperfection or the like; as also ↓ انمحص ; and ↓ إِمَّحَصَ ; and ↓ أَمْحَصَ ; and ↓ مَحَصَ , q. v.] ―
-b2- [Hence,] تمحّصت ذُنُوبُهُ (tropical:) [His sins became purged away]. (A, TA.)
And تمحّصت الظَّلْمَآءُ (tropical:) The darkness became cleared away, or removed. (A, TA.) And الشَّمْسُ ↓ أَمْحَصَتِ , and ↓ انمحصت , (K,) and ↓ إِمَّحَصَت , (TA,) (assumed tropical:) The sun appeared, and became clear, after an eclipse. (K, TA.) And الرَّجُلُ ↓ أَمْحَصَ , (inf. n. إِمْحَاصٌ, TA) (assumed tropical:) The man recovered from his disease. (Ibn-'Abbád, K. *)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
